verification.note: Reproduced by reading the files. At docs/specs/file-detail-single-header.md:47-52, D2 still says the trail starts at the further right of two points: 12px past the menu/tree buttons, or 'the left edge of the box that holds the file's content'. It does not mention a 16px inset. At :184-185, §7 still says 'screens other than file pages see no change'. The spec file contains no '16px inside', '+ 8px' or 'centre line' wording. The code differs on both points. frontend/src/components/Header.tsx:87-95 sets the content term to align.left + Math.max(16, paddingLeft), and the result to Math.max(16, wanted - frame.left), so the trail sits at least 16px inside the content box and at least 16px from the header's left end. frontend/src/components/ChromeButtons.tsx:58 places the fixed chrome buttons at top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 8px). That component renders unconditionally, so the move applies on every screen, not only file pages; behavior.md:25-27 says the same. decisions.md:3 records that behavior.md supersedes D2 and §7 for this fix, but the spec document itself was not updated, so the claim of stale spec text holds.

specification_compliance: Code matches behavior.md's revised D2: the 16px minimum inset in Header.tsx:89 and :95, and the buttons at safe-area + 8px in ChromeButtons.tsx:58.
docs/specs/file-detail-single-header.md D2 (:47-52) and §7 (:184-185) still describe the behaviour from before the fix.
